title: Application Factory — Golden Bundle
description: Normative schema of the Golden Bundle (Slice D, ARCHITECTURE.md §14, ADR-0015 §7). A Golden Bundle is a validated, reproducible set of compatible component versions intended as a known-good composition. It pins concrete component versions and records its validated compatibility relationships explicitly; it never resolves, substitutes or assembles versions and never becomes a second source of truth for component metadata.

bundle_id.description: Stable identity of this Golden Bundle lineage.

bundle_version.description: Explicit public SemVer version of this bundle.

bundle_digest.description: Immutable content digest pinning this bundle's canonical form (excluding the digest field itself).

components.description: The pinned compatible component set — explicit component versions and artifact identities, in deterministic order.

compatibility.description: Explicit machine-readable record of the validated pairwise compatibility relationships of the pinned set.

certification.description: Certification evidence, required when lifecycle is certified or later (ARCHITECTURE.md §14).

semver.description: Explicit SemVer MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (ARCHITECTURE.md §11). A floating selector such as latest is not a version.

bundle_id.description: Stable, unique, deterministic Golden Bundle identity: lower snake_case or kebab-case, never reused as a floating selector (ARCHITECTURE.md §11, §14).

component_id.description: Stable component identity mirrored from the canonical Component Registry (ARCHITECTURE.md §11).

sha256_digest.description: Immutable content digest: sha256 followed by 64 hex characters (ARCHITECTURE.md §11).

sha256_digest_nullable.description: Nullable artifact digest: null when no artifact is published, otherwise sha256 hex (with optional sha256: prefix for registry compatibility).

iso8601_utc.description: UTC timestamp in ISO8601 format, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z.

bundle_state.description: Golden Bundle lifecycle state (ARCHITECTURE.md §14): draft → candidate → certified → deprecated → revoked.

artifact_type.description: Kind of artifact. none means no deployable artifact is published (explicit statement, never a floating selector).

dependency_kind.description: Declared dependency mechanism (ARCHITECTURE.md §18). database, internal_code, private_schema and internal_queue are forbidden and have no representation here.

pinned.description: True only when the artifact is selected by an immutable digest (ARCHITECTURE.md §1.3).

canonical_form.description: Factory-defined canonical artifact representation; null only for artifact_type 'none'.

from.description: The pinned component whose declared dependency this relationship validates.

to.description: The pinned dependency target of the relationship.

compatible.description: Explicit validated compatibility verdict for this pinned relationship. A Golden Bundle packages validated compatible relationships, so a declared dependency edge must be recorded as compatible.

pairs.description: The validated pairwise compatibility relationships of the pinned set, in deterministic order.

certified_by.description: Accountable actor or process that certified the bundle.

certification_id.description: Stable identity of this certification record.

checks.description: The approved validation checks that passed for certification (ARCHITECTURE.md §14): compatibility matrix, contract tests, E2E, migration paths, smoke/load validation, artifact signature.
